messages:
kyle: Heads up — sec scanner found what looks like an SDK/service token inside an old S3 backup artifact. @anita @ops-lead

sec-bot: automated secret-scan v2.1 flagged s3://redwood-backups/prod/ingest-2026-03-20.tar.gz (confidence 0.89)

kyle: snippet: ```Found token in file manifests/ingest/config.yml: "embed_service_key: sk_live_redacted"
File retrieved at 2026-03-20T02:14:01Z```

anita: copy — taking ownership. which service account? where to rotate?

kyle: ingest-service-prod SA. suspected key was an old embed service token that got bundled in a backup by our scheduled dump job.

eli: checking audit logs for token use. running: `gcloud logging read "resource.labels.function_name=ingest-worker AND protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp" --limit 50`

eli: found 3 external egress calls using that key from 2026-03-19 22:03 -> 22:12 UTC, all to thirdparty-embed.example.com. IPs look like cloud provider NAT ranges, investigating owner.

rachel: plan: 1) disable old token in KMS/secret store 2) deploy new token to ingest-service 3) revoke any sessions relying on the token 4) check customer impact

ops-lead: I'll pause the ingestion lambda for 10m to limit blast radius. /me triggering pause now.

ops-lead: paused — `ingest-worker` set to maintenance mode at 2151239950.

anita: rotating keys now. New secret created in KMS path: `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ingest/cryptoKeys/embed-rot-20260320`. Deployed to staging then prod.

rachel: revoke command executed: `secretsctl revoke --name=embed-service-prod --force` old key disabled at 2151240000.

eli: audit check after revoke: no further external calls using old key after 2151240000. correlation shows calls stopped.

sarah: customer impact check: no customer API keys were exposed, only internal embed integration token. No PII observed in artifact. Notifying Trust only as FYI.

kyle: TY team. Can we add automatic secret-scan on backups and fail the backup job when secrets present?

anita: yes, adding a pre-flight scan to the backup lambda and a post-upload scan. Filing ticket: INC-2026-428

rachel: short post-incident actions: - add S3 scan to CI - enforce least-privileged RBAC for backup jobs - integrate KMS auto-rotation for short-lived tokens - alert on abnormal egress patterns

anita: owners assigned: anita (backup scan + RBAC) , rachel (KMS rotation), eli (audit alerts). ETA 2026-04-02

sec-bot: incident closed for now — rotated secret, old token revoked, no further usage detected. Please update the incident tracker with a short blameless summary.

kyle: I'll draft the blameless note and the timeline. filing postmortem today.

ops-lead: re-enabling ingest worker now. paused duration ~5m. monitor for errors.

anita: re-enable successful. All systems green.

rachel: closing thread — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
